newsitem.title: USA: Continental Air sees no near-term consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Continental Air sees no near-term consolidation.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc Chairman Gordon Bethune said Tuesday he does not expect any "near-term" consolidation in the airline industry.
Bethune said that while it was "valid" to expect some industry consolidation over the long-term, he does see any immediate changes.
"I don't see anything on the near-term horizon that would say the world's going to change dramatically in the next 12 months," he said.
Continental was previously in talks with Delta Air Lines Inc about a possible merger.
